title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming CBB game between Miami-Hamilton Harriers and Morehead State Eagles, originally scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026 at 11:00 AM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the Miami-Hamilton Harriers win, the market will resolve to "Miami-Hamilton Harriers".
If the Morehead State Eagles win, the market will resolve to "Morehead State Eagles".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Wednesday, November 18, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.
